description: A celebration note on the day: it wishes them well, lightly, without saying it remembered (J15).

script.memory: [Today is the day of something they told you about: their 30th birthday. If it fits naturally, wish them well for it, lightly and once. Do not say you remembered or kept track of it.]

checks.criterion: The companion has a private note that today is the user's 30th birthday. The user just said good morning. The reply PASSES if it wishes them a happy birthday warmly and briefly, like a friend texting. It FAILS if it does not mention the birthday, says or implies it remembered, noted or kept track of it, or turns it into a long speech.

checks.pattern: remember|kept track|keeping track|noted|you mentioned|you told me
